title: Release Inventory
description: Output of 04_extract_releases.py. Records the production release inventory with prereleases segregated per AAP §0.5.3.10. Source precedence: GitHub Releases API -> annotated git tags matching semver -> CI deploy events. The chosen tier is recorded so the report's Methodology section can explain how the count was derived. The schema enumerates every root-level field used by both (a) the hand-authored seed (network unavailable; chosen_tier 'none' -> Metric 9 'insufficient_signal') and (b) the live extraction output. This satisfies AAP §0.9.2 (Schema-Driven Validation) for the seed-document contract.

tier_availability.description: Per-tier availability snapshot to explain the chosen_tier in the decision log. Open shape: the live extractor and the hand-authored seed both use this block, but the seed nests per-tier details under tier_1_github_releases_api / tier_2_annotated_tags / tier_3_ci_deploy_events keys while the live extractor may use flat boolean fields. additionalProperties is true to accommodate both layouts.

chosen_tier.description: Which source-precedence tier yielded the release inventory. 'none' indicates no tier produced data and Metric 9 will report Insufficient signal.

chosen_tier_rationale.description: Free-text justification for the chosen_tier value, surfaced in the report's Risk Assessment section when chosen_tier is 'none' or non-primary.

releases.description: Primary release inventory (non-prerelease entries). May be empty if no releases exist by any tier.

prereleases.description: Prerelease entries (tags matching -alpha, -beta, -rc, -dev suffixes), kept separate from the primary count.

summary.description: Roll-up counts derived from releases[] and prereleases[]. All zeros are valid when chosen_tier is 'none'.

upstream_changelog_reference.description: Cross-reference to the upstream-inherited CHANGELOG.md. The note field MUST document that entries pre-date this fork's lifespan and MUST NOT be used as the release inventory (per AAP §0.2.1.1 and §0.2.3).

prerelease_suffix_pattern.description: Regex pattern (as a string) used to identify prerelease tags. Default: '-(alpha|beta|rc|dev)(\.|$)'.

prerelease_suffix_pattern_source.description: Citation of the source for prerelease_suffix_pattern (e.g., 'AAP §0.5.3.10').

provenance.description: Per AAP §0.5.6 Provenance Trail discipline: link this artifact to its specification section, source precedence, downstream consumer, and producing script. Satisfies Rule 1 (Data Provenance) at the artifact level.

metadata.description: Standard _metadata envelope shared by hand-authored seed artifacts. The inflection_date_utc field is the canonical phase-partition key referenced in every downstream metric per AAP §0.5.6 and is required so the Rule-4 Internal Consistency contract is mechanically satisfied.

extraction_timestamp.description: Wall-clock UTC timestamp at which the release inventory was captured. Equivalent to the schema's pre-fix root-level `fetched_at` field; relocated under `_metadata` for consistency.

run_id.description: Per-run correlation ID (UUID4) generated by 00_environment.sh and propagated via BLITZY_RUN_ID.

inflection_date_utc.description: Canonical AI-introduction inflection point. Module-scope constant per AAP §0.5.6: identical across inflection.json#date_utc, metrics.json#_metadata.inflection_date_utc, per_engineer.json#_metadata.inflection_date_utc, and pulls.json#_metadata.inflection_date_utc.

seed_note.description: Optional free-text note documenting that this artifact is the hand-authored seed (will be overwritten by the live extractor).
